# Cleo Spiers

> Personal website of Cleo Spiers, a software engineer in Seattle who also writes and takes photographs.

Cleo studied computer science and psychology at the University of Oklahoma. Their work has spanned medical research, machine learning infrastructure, and tools for emergency response.

## Pages

- [Home](https://cleosp.com/): Biography, employment, résumé, writing, and photography previews.
- [Work](https://cleosp.com/#work): Employment history and résumé.
- [Writing](https://cleosp.com/#writing): A screenplay excerpt and a mathematical note.
- [Photography](https://cleosp.com/photography.html): 25 photographs, including portraits, interiors, streets, and landscapes. Each image has descriptive alt text and a link to a larger version.

## Documents

- [Résumé](https://cleosp.com/assets/cleo-spiers-resume.pdf): Résumé (PDF).
- [chaser](https://cleosp.com/assets/chaser-excerpt.pdf): Screenplay excerpt, 5 pages (PDF).
- [Seymour’s Second Neighborhood Conjecture: an order bound](https://cleosp.com/assets/seymour-order-bound.pdf): Mathematical note, 2 pages (PDF).
